background: Bank of America Corporation is the holding company of the second-largest US bank, spanning consumer banking, wealth management under Merrill and a global corporate and investment bank.
synthesis: All three main agencies rate the group, A+ on average and the weakest of them at A-, all on a stable outlook, with the last move a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 3 May 2023. The weak spot is the balance sheet against US peers: CET1 of 11.2% is in the bottom quarter, leverage of 5.5% is below the median and LCR of 112% is below the median too. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods, so the position is stable rather than deteriorating. The newest flagged items, on 6 Oct 2026, concern fraud and cybercrime losses across the US market rather than the bank's own credit.
